title: Heat Pump Buyer's Remorse? This Alternative Works Better
summary: A UK homeowner chose a cheap air-to-air heat pump over a grant-funded air-to-water quote, kept his gas boiler, and reports savings using solar and an overnight EV tariff.

assertions.quote: a Daikin air-to-air heat pump with three indoor units, which has taken care of all of our heating needs for 5,300 pounds.

verdicts.note: In the UK, ductless air-to-air installs typically cost a fraction of air-to-water systems with cylinders and radiator upgrades.
